title: anyone can ask what SocialUs can and can't do, and get a short true answer

criteria.text: One answer by who is asking: a visitor, a member, someone who runs a Page or event; each a short list of can and can't yet
Plain and brief: one line per thing, no ticket or scenario numbers, under 1,500 words
criteria.note: 33 hand-kept lines in `capability-words.json`, 582 words dry run (#1245) [V]. Checked: `[guards F129.2]` in `tests/knowledge-capabilities.test.ts`.

criteria.text: Can means proven: a line is "can" only when its slice is shipped and its checks and live smoke test pass
criteria.note: Rule built in #1245; PR body marks 'Proven live (F129.3, F129.7): partial', because the overnight smoke tests screens, not criteria [V]. Checked: `[guards F129.3]` in `tests/knowledge-capabilities.test.ts`.

criteria.text: Can't yet says why: the condition it waits on, or "not planned", "not built yet" or "built, waiting on its checks"
criteria.note: `set_capability` refuses any other reason (#1245; amended in plan #311) [V]. Checked: `[guards F129.4]` in `tests/knowledge-capabilities.test.ts` and the SQL suite.

criteria.text: Asked through the store: "what can SocialUs do", optionally for one kind of person, is one lookup call with each line linked to its feature
A pack for a chat project: the same answer as one Markdown file in `socialus-plan` when a slice ships, is withdrawn or changes condition, and monthly
criteria.note: `packs/what-socialus-can-do.md` sent by auto-merging PR on `knowledge-capabilities.yml` (11:47 UTC) (#1245) [V]. Checked: only `[guards F129.6 partial]` in `tests/knowledge-capabilities.test.ts`.

criteria.text: It stays true: if a "can" line's live smoke test fails, the line moves to "can't right now" until it passes
criteria.note: Built via the open `bug · live:` Issue and the smoke report, screen-level only (#1245) [V]. Checked: `[guards F129.7]` in `tests/knowledge-capabilities.test.ts`.

criteria.text: It takes over the hand-run capabilities page after a week side by side
criteria.note: Not built [V]: #1245 PR body 'F129.8 ... #1246'. #1246 (open) needs a week of nightly packs and `PLAN_PACK_TOKEN`.
